LESSON: FAIR TREATMENT OF WORKERS

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Muamalaat (Social Relations)
Topic 6.1: Fair Treatment of Workers
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Fair Treatment of Workers, part of Muamalaat (Social Relations) in Grade 6 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: Why should workers be treated well? 2. How can we treat workers fairly?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.
